caption:
The best thing for your Christmas photos happens eight days before them.

I used to try to fix my face on the morning of a big day. It never works. Sleep, clean skin and less salt show up after a week, not a morning.

Number 6 surprised me most. A salty dinner leaves my face puffier the next morning, every time.

Which one are you starting tonight?

Save this for your Christmas countdown, and send it to the friend who's hosting this year.
